shortlist.label: Hypopharyngeal cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the left pyriform fossa and high metabolic activity in the hypopharyngeal mass

shortlist.label: Laryngeal cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Mass invading and compressing the left hemilarynx and fixed larynx

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck
shortlist.why_kept: Poorly differentiated malignant tumour and upper aerodigestive tract obstruction

shortlist.label: Thyroid cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Ill-defined hypoechoic mass involving the upper pole of the left thyroid lobe

shortlist.label: Metastatic disease to the head and neck

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including a left pyriform fossa mass invading and compressing the left hemilarynx, are consistent with hypopharyngeal cancer, which is a type of head and neck cancer that originates in the hypopharynx.

rejected.label: Laryngeal cancer
rejected.why: While the mass is affecting the larynx, the primary site of the tumor is the left pyriform fossa, which is part of the hypopharynx.

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes hypopharyngeal cancer, but it is not a specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Thyroid cancer
rejected.why: The mass is primarily located in the hypopharynx and is invading the thyroid lobe, but the primary site is not the thyroid gland.

rejected.label: Metastatic disease to the head and neck
rejected.why: The imaging findings suggest a primary tumor in the hypopharynx with metastasis to the lymph nodes and possibly the bone, rather than a metastatic tumor to the head and neck from a distant site.
